charges-1-delay-0.description: Four-slot capture bank, overflow returns to captured side. Capture/return cooldown 0 owner turns. Initial reserves ready. Checking-drop charges start at 0, cap 1; each non-checking-drop own play action restores one. Checking drop spends one with no same-turn recharge. King placement does not charge; board checks cost nothing. Drop-mate allowed when charged. Normal checkmate, stalemate and repetition rules.
text: The 4×4 board starts empty; White places a king on rank 1, then Black on rank 4.
On each later turn, move one deployed piece or drop one owned reserve piece on an empty square.
A drop may give check, just like a normal move.
Research variant: balance-bench.
Captures transfer to the capturer up to 4 held pieces; overflow returns to the captured side.

Bench options: {"captureDelay":0,"checkChargeCap":1}. Delays tick after the reserve owner's completed play turns, excluding the capture turn for new arrivals. Forced wait only without legal actions and outside check; it consumes one ply. Initial reserves are ready.
Captured non-kings join the capturer’s reserve if fewer than 4 pieces are held; otherwise return to the captured side’s reserve.

Checking-drop charges start at zero with maximum 1. A checking drop spends one and gives no recharge that turn; every other own play action restores one up to the cap. King placement does not charge. Normal checks spend nothing; drop-mate allowed when charged.
Normal king safety and checkmate apply; stalemate and threefold repetition are draws.

learning.behavior: Shallow alpha-beta; seeded random choice among equally scored moves.

steady.behavior: Medium alpha-beta; seeded random choice among equally scored moves.

sharp.behavior: Research Sharp: history-aware alpha-beta and objective-aware evaluation; among equally scored moves, prefers the resulting position seen fewer times, while retaining a draw that avoids a worse score.

notes: Check-charge-v1: charge banks start at zero, cap 1/2/3, recharge one on each non-checking-drop own play turn, no recharge on checking-drop or king placement. Drop mates allowed when charged. Capture cooldown 0/1; six recipes, six fresh seeds, 16 starts each, 576 Research Sharp depth-4 games. Objective-search-v3 adapter; do not pool datasets.
